about: Autopsy table modelled as a generic product: pedestal on base plate with levelling feet and control keys; dished tray with rims, removable grid slats, drain channel, downdraught slots; sink at the foot with waste, gooseneck tap and lever, spray hose holder and head rest. Water, drainage, gases and extract reach this item via the nested shared FMC_P_MechEq_ServicePoint (Medical Equipment cannot hold pipe or duct connectors). Reference: query: table autopsy medical equipment hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=table+autopsy+medical+equipment+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
